data.title: Jobcenter invitation for 22 April 2026
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen invites Lea Muster to a meeting on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 in room 1.18 with Ms Petzold about her current job situation. Missing it without good reason can reduce her Bürgergeld by 10%.
data.explanation: This is a formal invitation (Meldeaufforderung) from the Jobcenter. You must attend the appointment on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 in room 1.18 and bring your CV (Lebenslauf). If you don't come without an important reason, your Bürgergeld is cut by 10% of the standard rate (Regelbedarf) for one month. If you can't attend, contact the Jobcenter as early as possible, ideally before the date, and give your reason. A counselling service can help if you are unsure.
